entities.summary: Hisashi Kimura was a astronomers & cosmologists in Kanazawa (1870-09-10, Kanazawa – 1943-09-26) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with causality and historical consequence. Expanded astronomical understanding and cosmological models.
